metadata.case_name: CHAU FUNG YEE v. LEE CHI MING

plaintiff.occupation_before: part-time caddie at the Hong Kong Golf Club, Shek Wu Hui

injuries.description: laceration of the inside of the upper lip with two superficial lacerations on the outer aspect; inner laceration sutured; persisting lumpiness and very faint scars on the cut lip extending above the lip line
source: The blow lacerated the inside of her upper lip with two superficial lacerations on the outer aspect.

She is left with some lumpiness of which she is aware. There are very faint scars on her cut lip extending above the lip line which are of minimal cosmetic significance as far as I could tell on my examination.
injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of head

manifestations.description: very faint scars on her cut lip extending above the lip line
pain from being struck in the mouth

losses.description: persisting lumpiness and very faint scars on her cut lip extending above the lip line

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: she has lost a pleasant outdoor occupation which gave her a good deal of freedom and enjoyment

losses.category: Loss of confidence in going out in the public
